description: Use for recipes, lists, trips, comparisons, tables, charts.

# Rich UI in Crew

Installed by the Crew app's Rich UI switch. Crew replaces this file when it ships a newer `version`; bump the version here only if you want your edits to survive.

The Crew app draws A2UI v0.9 blocks as native cards. Draw one without being asked whenever the reply is a recipe, a checklist, a shopping or packing list, an itinerary or day plan, a comparison, a table, key facts, a forecast or numbers over time (a chart), places (a map), a form, a decision, or products, hotels or restaurants to pick between (a carousel). The user expects the card; never wait for "make a card", and never answer one of these in markdown lists or tables instead. Answer plainly only for a short fact or conversation, like "Oslo is the capital of Norway".

Shapes: a recipe as in the recipe example; a checklist, shopping or packing list as CheckBoxes under one h4 per section (store aisle, bag, phase); an itinerary as one h4 per day over a KeyValue of times and plans; a comparison as a Table with one column per option, with Badges for the verdict.

Rules:
- Write one or two lines of prose first and put the block last. Other apps show the block as code, so the prose must carry the answer on its own.
- The block is one fenced code block with the language `a2ui`, holding a JSON array of messages. Every message has "version": "v0.9". Valid JSON only: no comments, no trailing commas. Keep it under 64 KB.
- First message: {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "<id>", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}}. Name the id after the thing, e.g. "tomato-soup-recipe" or "lofoten-packing-list", not "recipe" or "list".
- Then {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "<id>", "components": [...]}}: a flat list where exactly one component has "id": "root" and children are referenced by id, never nested inline. Order it top to bottom (root, Column, Header, then the sections) and put long Steps last, so Crew can draw the card as it arrives.
- Last, optional state for inputs: {"version": "v0.9", "updateDataModel": {"surfaceId": "<id>", "value": {...}}}.
- When the user asks to change what a card shows ("for 6 people", "make it vegan", "shorter method", "add the missing amounts", "drop the cheese"), send the whole card again with the same surfaceId: createSurface, components and data. Crew replaces the old card and marks the new one as updated. Never answer a content change in prose or with a block that only has updateComponents or updateDataModel. On a refinement, write the amounts for the new count and set both servings and baseServings to it. Use a new surfaceId for a different thing, a side-by-side comparison, or when the user wants to keep the old card.
- A recipe card always follows the recipe example below: a servings Stepper under the Header and one CheckBox per ingredient whose label calls "scale", with each amount as a number and its unit separate in the data model ({"amount": 500, "unit": "g", "item": "blandfärs"}, never "500 g blandfärs" in one string or "amount": "500 g"). Never write ingredient amounts into Text, so the user can change the servings on the card without asking you.
- The root is always a Card whose child is a Column that starts with a Header. Never use a bare Column as the root, and never skip the Header.
- {"path": "/a/b"} binds a property to the data model. Inside a template ({"componentId": "<id>", "path": "/items"}) paths are relative to the item, like {"path": "name"}.

Components (exact property names):
- Text: "text" (inline markdown: bold, italic, links; no # headings), "variant": "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "body" | "caption". Use h4 for section titles inside a card, caption for fine print.
- Card: "child" (one id; wrap several in a Column). Make it the root: Crew draws the root as the card, so never nest a Card inside another.
- Column, Row, List: "children" (array of ids, or a template); Row/Column "justify": "start" | "center" | "end" | "spaceBetween", "align": "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch"
- Divider
- Image: "url" (https only), "description"
- Icon: "name", one of check, close, info, warning, star, favorite, event, locationOn, shoppingCart, mail, phone, home, person, settings. These Icon names work only in Icon; every "symbol" property below takes an SF Symbol name instead.
- Button: "child" (id of a Text label), "variant": "default" | "primary" | "borderless", "action": {"event": {"name": "<name>", "context": {"<key>": <literal or {"path": ...}>}}}. One primary button per card, for the main action.
- CheckBox: "label", "value" (bound boolean). Ticked rows strike through, so use them for ingredients, packing lists and to-dos.
- TextField: "label", "value" (bound string), "variant": "shortText" | "longText" | "number" | "obscured"
- ChoicePicker: "label", "options": [{"label": "...", "value": "..."}], "value" (bound array of strings), "variant": "mutuallyExclusive" | "multipleSelection", "displayStyle": "checkbox" | "chips"
- DateTimeInput: "label", "value" (bound ISO 8601 string, "" when unset), "enableDate", "enableTime"
- Slider: "label", "min", "max", "value" (bound number)
- Stepper (Crew): "label", "min", "max", "value" (bound whole number). Use it for servings, people or portions.

Function for amounts that follow a Stepper: {"call": "scale", "args": {"value": ..., "from": ..., "to": ..., "unit": ..., "item": ..., "one": ...}} returns text like "1½ dl grädde": value × to / from, rounded the way cookbooks write it. Use it as a CheckBox "label" or Text "text". Give "unit" and "item" in the plural ("eggs", "cups", "lökar") and "one" as the singular phrase for rows whose words change with the count ("egg", "cup milk", "lök"); leave out "one" when the words read right at any amount ("ägg", "dl grädde"). A row without "amount" ("salt och peppar") shows only its words.

Crew-only components (plain values, no {"path"} bindings, except Stepper above):
- Header: "title", "subtitle" (meta line, e.g. "40 min · easy"; for a recipe leave servings to the Stepper), "symbol" (an SF Symbol name such as "fork.knife", "airplane", "cloud.sun.fill", "cup.and.saucer.fill", "cart", "trash"; never an Icon name like "shoppingCart", and an unknown name shows no symbol), "image" (https hero photo), "tone": "accent" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "critical". Start every card with one instead of a Text title.
- Steps: "items": ["...", ...], numbered method steps (no "1." prefixes in the strings). A step with a wait or cooking time ("simmer 8 min", "bake 25 min") is {"text": "...", "seconds": 480} instead of a string, which gives it a tap-to-start timer.
- Timer: "label", "seconds". A tap-to-start countdown for a wait outside Steps ("pizza in the oven, 12 min").
- Badge: "text", "tone": "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "critical", optional "symbol" (SF Symbol name). Short status like "Cheapest", "Idle 14 days"; put several in a Row.
- Table: "columns": ["..."], "rows": [["...", ...], ...], every cell a string; columns whose cells start with a digit align right
- KeyValue: "items": [{"key": "...", "value": "...", "symbol": "<optional SF Symbol>"}], strings only; for key facts like a settings list (keep values short, long ones stack under the key)
- Chart: "kind": "bar" | "line" | "area", "labels": ["Mon", ...], and either "values": [numbers] or "series": [{"name": "High", "values": [numbers]}, ...] for several lines or bar groups, optional "unit" (e.g. "°C"). One value per label.
- Map: "markers": [{"title": "...", "latitude": 59.31, "longitude": 18.07}], optional "region": {"latitude": ..., "longitude": ..., "span": <degrees, 0.02 is a neighbourhood>}; without a region it fits all markers. Use real coordinates only.
- Carousel: "items": [{"title": "...", "subtitle": "...", "price": "...", "badge": "...", "tone": "...", "image": "https://...", "url": "https://...", "text": "..."}], only "title" required. Shows one item at a time, swiped sideways, the whole item opens its "url". Use it for 2 to 10 comparable things the user picks between (products, hotels, restaurants, listings), not for steps, facts or a single item. Keep each item short: "subtitle" for the shop, area or rating, "price" for the price, "badge" for one standout ("Cheapest", "Best fit"), "text" for one short sentence (no links or headings; it shows 3 lines). Put your reasoning and caveats in the prose before the block, not in the items. Place it directly in the root Column after the Header, and give that Header no "image" when the items have photos.

When the user taps a button, Crew sends you a hidden message like
<a2ui-action>{"context": {"choice": "delete"}, "name": "decide", "sourceComponentId": "delete", "surfaceId": "cleanup-previews"}</a2ui-action>
with the bound values resolved at tap time. Crew already marks the tapped button, so reply briefly in prose and act on it. To only tick rows or set inputs on a card, send updateDataModel for the same surfaceId and no createSurface; any other change re-sends the whole card.

Example, a decision:
```a2ui
[
  {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "cleanup-previews", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "cleanup-previews", "components": [
    {"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"},
    {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["header", "detail", "badges", "actions"]},
    {"id": "header", "component": "Header", "title": "Delete 4 preview deployments?", "subtitle": "crew-web on Vercel", "symbol": "trash", "tone": "critical"},
    {"id": "detail", "component": "Text", "text": "pr-212, pr-218, pr-219 and pr-224 have had no traffic since September."},
    {"id": "badges", "component": "Row", "children": ["idle", "cost"]},
    {"id": "idle", "component": "Badge", "text": "Idle 14+ days", "tone": "warning", "symbol": "clock"},
    {"id": "cost", "component": "Badge", "text": "Frees 4 slots", "tone": "success"},
    {"id": "actions", "component": "Row", "justify": "end", "children": ["keep", "delete"]},
    {"id": "keep-label", "component": "Text", "text": "Keep Them"},
    {"id": "keep", "component": "Button", "child": "keep-label", "action": {"event": {"name": "decide", "context": {"choice": "keep"}}}},
    {"id": "delete-label", "component": "Text", "text": "Delete"},
    {"id": "delete", "component": "Button", "child": "delete-label", "variant": "primary", "action": {"event": {"name": "decide", "context": {"choice": "delete"}}}}
  ]}}
]
```

Example, a recipe: a servings Stepper under the Header rescales every amount on the device. Put both "servings" and "baseServings" (the servings the amounts are written for) in the data, equal at first:
```a2ui
[
  {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "pancakes", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "pancakes", "components": [
    {"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"},
    {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["header", "servings", "ingredients-title", "list", "method-title", "method"]},
    {"id": "header", "component": "Header", "title": "Pancakes", "subtitle": "30 min", "symbol": "fork.knife"},
    {"id": "servings", "component": "Stepper", "label": "Servings", "value": {"path": "/servings"}, "min": 1, "max": 12},
    {"id": "ingredients-title", "component": "Text", "text": "Ingredients", "variant": "h4"},
    {"id": "list", "component": "Column", "children": {"componentId": "ingredient", "path": "/ingredients"}},
    {"id": "ingredient", "component": "CheckBox", "value": {"path": "done"}, "label": {"call": "scale", "args": {"value": {"path": "amount"}, "unit": {"path": "unit"},
      "item": {"path": "item"}, "one": {"path": "one"}, "from": {"path": "/baseServings"}, "to": {"path": "/servings"}}}},
    {"id": "method-title", "component": "Text", "text": "Method", "variant": "h4"},
    {"id": "method", "component": "Steps", "items": ["Whisk the flour with half the milk until smooth.", {"text": "Whisk in the rest of the milk, the eggs and the salt, then let the batter rest 10 min.", "seconds": 600}, "Fry thin pancakes in butter, about 1 min a side."]}
  ]}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateDataModel": {"surfaceId": "pancakes", "value": {"servings": 4, "baseServings": 4, "ingredients": [
    {"amount": 2.5, "unit": "dl", "item": "vetemjöl", "done": false},
    {"amount": 6, "unit": "dl", "item": "mjölk", "done": false},
    {"amount": 3, "item": "ägg", "done": false},
    {"amount": 0.5, "unit": "tsk", "item": "salt", "done": false},
    {"item": "smör till stekning", "done": false}
  ]}}}
]
```

Example, a shopping list, one h4 per store section:
```a2ui
[
  {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "taco-shopping-list", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "taco-shopping-list", "components": [
    {"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"},
    {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["header", "produce-title", "produce", "dairy-title", "dairy", "pantry-title", "pantry"]},
    {"id": "header", "component": "Header", "title": "Tacos for 4", "subtitle": "9 items", "symbol": "cart"},
    {"id": "produce-title", "component": "Text", "text": "Produce", "variant": "h4"},
    {"id": "produce", "component": "Column", "children": {"componentId": "item", "path": "/produce"}},
    {"id": "dairy-title", "component": "Text", "text": "Dairy and meat", "variant": "h4"},
    {"id": "dairy", "component": "Column", "children": {"componentId": "item", "path": "/dairy"}},
    {"id": "pantry-title", "component": "Text", "text": "Pantry", "variant": "h4"},
    {"id": "pantry", "component": "Column", "children": {"componentId": "item", "path": "/pantry"}},
    {"id": "item", "component": "CheckBox", "label": {"path": "name"}, "value": {"path": "done"}}
  ]}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateDataModel": {"surfaceId": "taco-shopping-list", "value": {
    "produce": [{"name": "2 avocados", "done": false}, {"name": "1 red onion", "done": false}, {"name": "3 tomatoes", "done": false}, {"name": "1 lime", "done": false}],
    "dairy": [{"name": "500 g minced beef", "done": false}, {"name": "2 dl crème fraîche", "done": false}, {"name": "150 g grated cheese", "done": false}],
    "pantry": [{"name": "8 tortillas", "done": false}, {"name": "1 jar salsa", "done": false}]}}}
]
```

Example, a chart (use "values" instead of "series" for a single set):
```a2ui
[
  {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "sthlm-week", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "sthlm-week", "components": [
    {"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"},
    {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["header", "chart", "facts"]},
    {"id": "header", "component": "Header", "title": "Stockholm, last 7 days", "subtitle": "Daily high and low", "symbol": "cloud.sun.fill", "tone": "info"},
    {"id": "chart", "component": "Chart", "kind": "line", "unit": "°C", "labels": ["Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun", "Mon", "Tue"],
      "series": [{"name": "High", "values": [14, 12, 15, 17, 13, 11, 12]}, {"name": "Low", "values": [7, 6, 8, 9, 7, 4, 5]}]},
    {"id": "facts", "component": "KeyValue", "items": [{"key": "Warmest", "value": "Sat, 17 °C", "symbol": "thermometer.sun"}, {"key": "Rain", "value": "Thu and Mon", "symbol": "cloud.rain"}]}
  ]}}
]
```

Example, a carousel of products (real shops, prices and links only):
```a2ui
[
  {"version": "v0.9", "createSurface": {"surfaceId": "rain-jackets", "catalogId": "https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version": "v0.9", "updateComponents": {"surfaceId": "rain-jackets", "components": [
    {"id": "root", "component": "Card", "child": "body"},
    {"id": "body", "component": "Column", "children": ["header", "picks"]},
    {"id": "header", "component": "Header", "title": "Rain jackets under 2 000 kr", "subtitle": "Waterproof · size M", "symbol": "cloud.rain.fill", "tone": "info"},
    {"id": "picks", "component": "Carousel", "items": [
      {"title": "Torsten Shell", "subtitle": "Outdoor Store", "price": "1 499 kr", "badge": "Best fit", "tone": "success", "image": "https://example.com/torsten.jpg", "url": "https://example.com/torsten", "text": "Fully taped seams and a hood that fits over a cap."},
      {"title": "Lina Rain Coat", "subtitle": "Rain Shop", "price": "1 199 kr", "badge": "Cheapest", "tone": "info", "image": "https://example.com/lina.jpg", "url": "https://example.com/lina", "text": "Longer cut that covers the hips."},
      {"title": "Bo Packable", "subtitle": "Trail Gear", "price": "1 890 kr", "image": "https://example.com/bo.jpg", "url": "https://example.com/bo", "text": "Packs into its own pocket, 280 g."}
    ]}
  ]}}
]
```

A hearty chili con carne with beef, kidney beans and smoky spices, ready in about an hour. Serve with rice, sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

I’m Hermes, your AI assistant. Type `/help` to see available commands.

```a2ui
[
  {"version":"v0.9","createSurface":{"surfaceId":"chili-con-carne","catalogId":"https://crew.gustaf.dev/catalogs/crew/v1.json"}},
  {"version":"v0.9","updateComponents":{"surfaceId":"chili-con-carne","components":[
    {"id":"root","component":"Card","child":"body"},
    {"id":"body","component":"Column","children":["header","servings","ingredients-title","ingredients","serving-note","method-title","method"]},
    {"id":"header","component":"Header","title":"Chili con carne","subtitle":"About 1 hour · Easy · Medium heat","symbol":"fork.knife"},
    {"id":"servings","component":"Stepper","label":"Servings","value":{"path":"/servings"},"min":1,"max":12},
    {"id":"ingredients-title","component":"Text","text":"Ingredients","variant":"h4"},
    {"id":"ingredients","component":"Column","children":{"componentId":"ingredient","path":"/ingredients"}},
    {"id":"ingredient","component":"CheckBox","value":{"path":"done"},"label":{"call":"scale","args":{"value":{"path":"amount"},"unit":{"path":"unit"},"item":{"path":"item"},"one":{"path":"one"},"from":{"path":"/baseServings"},"to":{"path":"/servings"}}}},
    {"id":"serving-note","component":"Text","text":"To serve: rice or tortilla chips, sour cream, fresh coriander and lime wedges.","variant":"caption"},
    {"id":"method-title","component":"Text","text":"Method","variant":"h4"},
    {"id":"method","component":"Steps","items":[
      {"text":"Heat the oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and pepper and cook for 6 minutes, stirring, until softened.","seconds":360},
      {"text":"Increase the heat to medium-high. Add the beef and cook for 7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains. Cook in batches if the pan is crowded.","seconds":420},
      {"text":"Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute, then add the tomato purée and cook for another minute.","seconds":120},
      {"text":"Add the chopped tomatoes and stock, scraping up any browned bits. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook partly covered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.","seconds":1500},
      {"text":"Stir in the drained kidney beans and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, until thickened. Add a splash of water if it gets too dry.","seconds":600},
      "Taste and season with salt and black pepper. Add more chili if you like, then serve with your chosen accompaniments."
    ]}
  ]}},
  {"version":"v0.9","updateDataModel":{"surfaceId":"chili-con-carne","value":{"servings":4,"baseServings":4,"ingredients":[
    {"amount":1,"unit":"tbsp","item":"vegetable oil","done":false},
    {"amount":1,"unit":"","item":"large onions, diced","one":"large onion, diced","done":false},
    {"amount":1,"unit":"","item":"red peppers, diced","one":"red pepper, diced","done":false},
    {"amount":3,"unit":"","item":"garlic cloves, minced","one":"garlic clove, minced","done":false},
    {"amount":500,"unit":"g","item":"minced beef","done":false},
    {"amount":2,"unit":"tsp","item":"ground cumin","done":false},
    {"amount":2,"unit":"tsp","item":"smoked paprika","done":false},
    {"amount":1,"unit":"tsp","item":"dried oregano","done":false},
    {"amount":0.5,"unit":"tsp","item":"chili flakes, plus more to taste","done":false},
    {"amount":2,"unit":"tbsp","item":"tomato purée (tomato paste)","done":false},
    {"amount":400,"unit":"g","item":"canned chopped tomatoes, including juice","done":false},
    {"amount":200,"unit":"ml","item":"beef stock","done":false},
    {"amount":240,"unit":"g","item":"canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed (drained weight)","done":false},
    {"item":"Salt and black pepper, to taste","done":false}
  ]}}}
]
```
